mechanism: Ethambutol can cause optic neuritis and peripheral neuropathy, which may complicate the neurological assessment of Parkinson's disease patients on carbidopa-levodopa and potentially interfere with levodopa efficacy through effects on dopaminergic pathways.
action: Monitor for visual changes and peripheral neuropathy; ensure baseline and periodic ophthalmologic exams during ethambutol therapy; assess for worsening Parkinson's symptoms and adjust levodopa dosing if needed.
